script.title: King of the Whispering Woods
script.logline: A brave lion ventures into a mystical forest to confront an ancient shadow.
script.color_palette: emerald green, sunset gold, amethyst purple, rich amber

panels.description: Wide establishing shot in anime style. Leo, a majestic golden-furred lion with a glowing crimson mane, stands defiantly atop a mossy stone looking into the dense, foggy Whispering Woods. Dramatic low angle, sunbeams cutting through the canopy.
panels.speaker: Leo
panels.dialogue: Ancient forest... show me what you've got.
panels.caption: At the edge of the uncharted wild, a new legend begins.

panels.description: Medium action shot. Swirling purple shadows and glowing blue roots erupt from the forest floor, blocking Leo's path. Leo leaps forward, claws extended, muscles tensed in mid-air with dynamic speed lines.
panels.speaker: Leo

panels.description: Close-up of Leo letting out a mighty roar. A shockwave of golden spiritual energy bursts from his mouth, shattering the dark roots into sparkling dust. Extreme dynamic angle, glowing eyes, swirling debris.
panels.speaker: Leo
panels.caption: Courage is the ultimate weapon.

panels.description: Peaceful wide shot. The fog parts completely, revealing a breathtaking hidden valley illuminated by magical flora. Leo sits proudly atop a hill, tail swishing calmly, gazing out at his newly claimed horizon as butterflies flutter around him.
panels.caption: And so, the darkness bowed to the light.
